meta.phase-name: game.ts Extraction Map and First Module Split

phase-summary.outcome: Completed the first bounded `game.ts` decomposition slice without changing runtime behavior. The extraction map is now explicit in `GAME_STRUCTURE.md`, and the engine moved pure helper logic, snapshot/restore preparation, and status/look view shaping into dedicated modules while keeping `GameEngine` as the orchestration entrypoint.

file.description: Removed the first tranche of pure helper/state-view logic and rewired the class to import the extracted modules.
Owns extracted pure helper logic including delta math, runtime labels, level/chapter helpers, and vector scaling/diff utilities.
Owns snapshot capture, restore-state preparation, and empty dialogue-progress defaults.
Owns status/look shaping helpers for inventory, spells, quests, dialogue progress, and text summary generation.
Updated the runtime decomposition section with the actual extracted files and the exact method-bucket map for later phases.

decision.summary: The first refactor slice should create import seams around helpers, persistence preparation, and view shaping before any action-family moves.
decision.impact: This keeps runtime behavior stable and gives `62-02` safe module boundaries to attach navigation, social, combat, inventory, and rune-forge action extractions to.

next.action: Start `62-02` by peeling `availabilityForAction` and the perform/execute action family branches into dedicated action modules while keeping `GameEngine.dispatch()` as the composition shell.
